income_recurrence_fields.name: income_recurrence_fields
income_recurrence_fields.value:
("income_sources"."recurrence" = 'monthly' AND "income_sources"."pay_day" IS NOT NULL AND "income_sources"."pay_day" BETWEEN 1 AND 31)
       OR ("income_sources"."recurrence" = 'once' AND "income_sources"."pay_date" IS NOT NULL AND "income_sources"."pay_date" GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-1][0-9]-[0-3][0-9]')

simulations_method_fields.name: simulations_method_fields
simulations_method_fields.value:
("simulations"."payment_method" = 'credit' AND "simulations"."card_id" IS NOT NULL AND "simulations"."installments_count" BETWEEN 1 AND 48)
       OR ("simulations"."payment_method" = 'debit' AND "simulations"."card_id" IS NULL AND "simulations"."installments_count" = 1)

settlements_exactly_one_source.name: settlements_exactly_one_source
settlements_exactly_one_source.value: ("monthly_settlements"."income_id" IS NOT NULL AND "monthly_settlements"."expense_id" IS NULL) OR ("monthly_settlements"."income_id" IS NULL AND "monthly_settlements"."expense_id" IS NOT NULL)
